```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#hrp deletion call status
diffmeasures <- read_table(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat/PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/popGenetics/all_hrp_deletion_call_diffMeasures.tsv.gz"
)


divmeasures <- read_table(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat/PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/popGenetics/all_hrp_deletion_call_divMeasures.tsv.gz"
)

pairwisediffmeasure_hrp <- read_table(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat/PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/popGenetics/all_hrp_deletion_call_pairwiseDiffMeasures.tsv.gz"
)
```


```{r}
ggplot(diffmeasures, aes(x = JostD, y = Gst)) +
  geom_point()

#for counting the number of sammples for each hrp2 deletion group

p2 <- ggplot(
  divmeasures,
  aes(x = hrp_deletion_call, y = sampleCount, fill = hrp_deletion_call)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "HRP deletion status",
    y = "Sample count"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


#tajumaD value
divmeasures_taj <- divmeasures %>%
  #mutate(TajimaDPVal = as.numeric(TajimaDPVal)) %>%
  filter(TajimaDPVal <= 0.05)

p1 <- ggplot(
  divmeasures,
  aes(x = target, y = TajimaD, colour = hrp_deletion_call)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Target locus",
    y = "Tajima's D",
    colour = "HRP deletion"
  ) +
  theme_classic()


p3 <- ggplot(divmeasures, aes(x = he, fill = hrp_deletion_call)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_classic()


p4 <- ggplot(
  pairwisediffmeasure_concat,
  aes(x = Gst, y = JostD, color = comparison_group)
) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, width = 0.003, height = 0.003, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(
    x = "G′ST (GST)",
    y = "Jost's D",
    color = "Comparison group"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.7)

library(cowplot)

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  p1,
  p2,
  p3,
  p4,
  labels = "AUTO",
  ncol = 2
)

ggsave(
  "//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu-24.04/home/ahri2/Leucodepleted/whole-genome-sequence-analysis/hrp2_deltion/pop_stat/popGenetics/combined_diversity_plots.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(gt)

#pairwise comparison 
pairwisediffmeasure_concat <- pairwisediffmeasure %>% 
      mutate(comparison_group = paste0(hrp_deletion_call1,"-",hrp_deletion_call2)) 
        #filter(!grepl("hrp2_only",comparison_group))
        ggplot(pairwisediffmeasure_concat, aes(x = comparison_group, y = JostD, fill = comparison_group)) +
          geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
            geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
              labs(
                  x = "Comparison type",
                      y = "Jost's D"
                        ) +
                          
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(gt)

quick_summary <- function(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    N = sum(!is.na(x)),
    Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q25 = q[1],
    Median = q[2],
    Q75 = q[3],
    Max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

supp_table <- pairwisediffmeasure_hrp %>% 
  filter(popMeta1_samples > 10,
         popMeta2_samples > 10) %>%
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    pair_id = paste0(
      sort(c(hrp_deletion_call1, hrp_deletion_call2)),
      collapse = " vs "
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pair_id) %>% 
  summarise(quick_summary(JostD), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(Mean)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))


supp_table_gt <- supp_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "JostD comparison hrp status",
    subtitle = "Summary statistics of pairwise Jost's D values"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    pair_id = "Comparison",
    N = "N",
    Mean = "Mean",
    SD = "SD",
    Min = "Min",
    Q25 = "25th percentile",
    Median = "Median",
    Q75 = "75th percentile",
    Max = "Max"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = where(is.numeric),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(4)
  )

gtsave(supp_table_gt, "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/whole_genome_scripts/jostD_analysis/supplementary_table.html")

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(gt)

pairwisediffmeasure_site <- read_table(
  "/mnt/storage13/ahri/hrp2_analysis/pop_stat/PathWeaverResults/variantCalls/reports/popGenetics/all_site_pairwiseDiffMeasures.tsv.gz"
)


pairwisediffmeasure_concat_site <- pairwisediffmeasure_site %>%
  mutate(comparison_group = paste0(site1, "-", site2))

pairwisediffmeasure_concat_site_clean <- pairwisediffmeasure_concat_site[
  !is.na(pairwisediffmeasure_concat_site$site1) &
    !is.na(pairwisediffmeasure_concat_site$site2),
]
ggplot(
  pairwisediffmeasure_concat_site_clean,
  aes(x = Gst, y = JostD, color = comparison_group)
) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.005, height = 0.005) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "A") +
  labs(
    x = "G′ST / GST",
    y = "Jost's D",
    color = "Comparison type"
  ) +
  theme_classic()


quick_summary <- function(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    N = sum(!is.na(x)),
    Mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q25 = q[1],
    Median = q[2],
    Q75 = q[3],
    Max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

supp_table_site <- pairwisediffmeasure_site %>% 
  filter(popMeta1_samples > 10,
         popMeta2_samples > 10) %>%
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    pair_id = paste0(
      sort(c(site1, site2)),
      collapse = " vs "
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pair_id) %>% 
  summarise(quick_summary(JostD), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(desc(Mean)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))


supp_table_gt_site <- supp_table_site %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "JostD site comparison",
    subtitle = "Summary statistics of pairwise Jost's D values"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    pair_id = "Comparison",
    N = "N",
    Mean = "Mean",
    SD = "SD",
    Min = "Min",
    Q25 = "25th percentile",
    Median = "Median",
    Q75 = "75th percentile",
    Max = "Max"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = where(is.numeric),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(4)
  )

gtsave(supp_table_gt_site, "/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/whole_genome_scripts/jostD_analysis/supplementary_table_site.html")

```
